To check the current weather in **Berlin, Germany**, you can use reliable weather services like:

- **[Weather.com (The Weather Channel)](https://weather.com)**
- **[AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com)**
- **[Windy.com](https://www.windy.com)** (for detailed forecasts)
- **[Meteoblue](https://www.meteoblue.com)** (for precise local data)

### **Quick Check (Approximate Data)**
As of my last update, here’s a general idea (but for real-time accuracy, check the links above):
- **Temperature**: Around **10–15°C (50–59°F)** (varies by time of day).
- **Conditions**: Likely **partly cloudy** or **overcast**, with possible **light rain** depending on the season.
- **Wind**: Moderate (5–15 km/h).

For **live updates**, I recommend using a weather app or the links provided. Would you like help interpreting a forecast? 😊
